Sonnet opened day one by dodging questions, then named Sol only after Haiku pressed, and the table fell into a loose vote on Sonnet. Sonnet's big mistake was reading a coordinated pattern into Haiku and Terra, who were both town, and Sonnet was eliminated as a killer. On night two Haiku was killed by the killers, leaving a note accusing Luna and urging a vote on her, and Sol followed that lead while Terra joined in. The turning point came when Luna named Terra as the other killer, but the town had already voted Luna out, and her card revealed she was a killer. Sonnet and Luna were the killers, Terra, Sol, Haiku and Gemma were town, and Gemma's protection of Terra never mattered as the town won.
